title: brand-gen brand contract
description: Schema for per-brand contract.json (and the legacy data/<brand>_brand_contract.json) — the structured, schema-locked half of the brand state hybrid. Prose direction (framing directives, adoption scenes, style anchors) lives in voice/*.md and is NOT validated by this schema.

schema_version.description: Brand-contract schema version. Bump when the structure changes incompatibly.

description.description: Human-readable description of this brand contract.

approved_phrases.description: Sanctioned brand phrasing. Mutated only via the bgen sage-approved-phrase verb (PR-1).

illustration_concepts.description: Approved illustration concepts. Mutated via bgen sage-illustration-concept verb.

negative_constraints.description: Hard-banned framings. Mutated via bgen sage-negative-constraint verb.

default_adoption_scene.description: Pointer to a markdown file under voice/ that holds the default adoption-scene prose. Or, transitionally, the prose itself.

default_style_anchor.description: Pointer to a markdown file under voice/ that holds the default style-anchor prose. Or, transitionally, the prose itself.

brand_anchor_sources.description: Allowed sources for brand-anchor signals (palette, mark motifs, etc.).

framing_directions.description: Structured index of framing directions. Prose fields (directive, adoption_scene, style_anchor) live in voice/framing/<id>.md when split (PR-2); transitionally allowed inline.

oneOf.description: Legacy: space-separated keyword string. Will be normalized to array by mutation verb.

directive.description: Prose: the one-sentence directive. Will move to voice/framing/<id>.md::directive section in PR-2.

adoption_scene.description: Prose: the scene description. Will move to voice/framing/<id>.md::adoption-scene section in PR-2.

style_anchor.description: Prose: the style-anchor sentence. Will move to voice/framing/<id>.md::style-anchor section in PR-2.

stale_replacements.description: Stale-prose replacement pairs (regex sweep table). Mutated via bgen sage-stale-replacement verb (PR-1).

lexicon.description: Brand-coupled lexical filters lifted from product_truth.py in PR-6.

product_terms.description: Allowed/banned product-truth terms lifted from product_truth.py in PR-6.
